lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11-12 distinct high-contrast vertical lines. Spacing is non-uniform, with greater interval distance in the mid-torso region and increased density towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 6th vertical line (counting from shoulder) where the line splits into a Y-shape near the dorsal ridge; secondary merging of line segments observed near the upper posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple abbreviated segments visible along the ventral margin, particularly between lines 4 and 8, where white pixel clusters terminate before reaching the mid-torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6-10 high-contrast white spots is localized on the lower posterior haunch, concentrated above the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A sequence of three spots on the mid-haunch aligns to form a horizontal geometric line parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white patch on the lower throat area and a distinct white horizontal band on the proximal region of the visible forelimb.
